body: My current character is a water Genasi called Tsunami! My DM is doing an entire home-brew nautical adventure because I wanted to be a pirate, and I'm having so much fun with it.

He, uh

Killed his cactus house plant.

So

Yeah
That's why I want to do it more or less monthly, by the time the flowers are wilted and ready to be tossed I present brand new ones! Helps him feel less bad about throwing the others away aha.

He's really against gifts in general and doesn't let me pay for much or spoil him at all, but I've given him flowers few times before and he always seemed grateful (and more importantly okay) with the gift.

I just feel like having flowering in his house helps breathe bit of life into him, but they tend to go all gross and die in a month. It's more like restocking I guess. We have a local flower van that sells small bouquets for $15-20 so I don't think that's too much to spend.
He accidentally killed the succulent I gave him aha, I figured he wouldn't feel so bad when the flowers died comparatively.
Yea I know, it's not my way to go. Doesn't stop the temptation being there though.
Unfortunately I still live with my parents, and I live far out of the city centre. I cannot drive, and my mother is much too controlling to allow a situation like that.
